steps.title: Prepare the frame
steps.instructions: Unpack the Twiglet 2" carbon toothpick frame and check it against frame.step (arms 42.5 mm from the centre to the motor shaft). Sand the cut edges lightly so they cannot chafe the motor wires.

steps.title: Mount the front motors
steps.instructions: Screw a 1103 15000KV (no-name) onto each front arm with M1.4 x 3 mm motor bolts, wires pointing to the hub. Use screws that do not touch the windings.

steps.title: Mount the rear motors
steps.instructions: Repeat on the rear arms with the other two 1103 15000KV (no-name). All four wires point to the hub.

steps.title: Seat the flight controller
steps.instructions: Put the soft-mount grommets on the stack mount and press the BetaFPV Matrix 1S 5IN1 V2 AIO onto them, arrow facing forward.

steps.title: Solder the motor wires
steps.instructions: Shorten each motor's three wires to reach its ESC pads and solder them. Front left and rear right spin one way, front right and rear left the other; swap two wires to reverse a motor.

steps.title: Fit the camera
steps.instructions: Solder the Caddx Ant 1200TVL nano camera's three wires to the camera pads (5V, GND, video) and seat it in the Toothpick canopy and battery holder (TPU), lens facing forward.

steps.title: Fit the battery
steps.instructions: Slide the Tattu R-Line 1S 550mAh 95C into the battery holder on the canopy, centred so the drone balances on the hub. Do not plug it in yet.

steps.title: Test the motors without propellers
steps.instructions: Connect USB, open Betaflight, check that the controller reads level, then plug in the battery and spin each motor slowly in the motor tab to check its direction.

steps.title: Fit the propellers
steps.instructions: Unplug the battery. Press a Gemfan 2020 51 mm 4-blade onto each motor shaft, matching each propeller's direction to its motor, then check that no blade touches the frame or a neighbour.

content:
# AnyBuild firmware: Betaflight CLI configuration
# Product: drone v1
# Flight controller: BetaFPV Matrix 1S 5IN1 V2 AIO
# Motors: 1103 15000KV (no-name)
# Propellers: Gemfan 2020 51 mm 4-blade
# Battery: Tattu R-Line 1S 550mAh 95C
# PID gains: defaults
# Paste into the Betaflight Configurator CLI tab and press Enter. The board saves and reboots.
# A motor that spins the wrong way: swap any two of its phase wires, or reverse it in the Motors tab.

batch start

# Motor order (Quad X, props in)
#   M1 rear right CW
#   M2 front right CCW
#   M3 rear left CCW
#   M4 front left CW
mixer QUADX
set yaw_motors_reversed = OFF
set motor_pwm_protocol = DSHOT300
set dshot_bidir = ON
set motor_poles = 12

# Battery
set vbat_max_cell_voltage = 420
set vbat_warning_cell_voltage = 350
set vbat_min_cell_voltage = 330

# Receiver and arming switch on AUX1
feature RX_SERIAL
set serialrx_provider = CRSF
aux 0 0 0 1700 2100 0 0

profile 0

set p_roll = 45
set i_roll = 80
set d_roll = 40
set f_roll = 120
set p_pitch = 47
set i_pitch = 84
set d_pitch = 46
set f_pitch = 125
set p_yaw = 45
set i_yaw = 80
set d_yaw = 0
set f_yaw = 120

rateprofile 0

set rates_type = ACTUAL
set roll_rc_rate = 7
set roll_srate = 67
set roll_expo = 0
set pitch_rc_rate = 7
set pitch_srate = 67
set pitch_expo = 0
set yaw_rc_rate = 7
set yaw_srate = 67
set yaw_expo = 0

batch end

save
explanation: Betaflight CLI for the BetaFPV Matrix 1S 5IN1 V2 AIO: Quad X motor order, DShot300, actual rates 70/670 deg/s, PID gains from Betaflight starting values for a 1S whoop. 11 wiring rows come straight from the bill of materials.
